title: Remove Launch history intent flat aliases
summary: Removed six additional Launch history/settings-intent flat compatibility aliases by routing readiness, command-history, launch-history, and smoke consumers through mediaPipelineLaunchView or mediaPipelineLaunchHistoryView.
reason: The active WebView cleanup workstream calls for opportunistic reduction of transitional window.* exports while preserving namespace-first access, browser smoke hooks, and backend-owned command boundaries.
behavior_before: launchView.js exported Launch settings-intent helpers and Launch command-history helpers as direct flat window.* aliases. Readiness, command history, launch history, and WebView smokes still had flat-global access paths for those helpers.
behavior_after: Readiness and command-history refreshes call mediaPipelineLaunchView, launchHistoryView resolves intent rows through its launchViewApi namespace helper, smokes require mediaPipelineLaunchHistoryView for command history, and launchView.js no longer exports launchSettingsIntentRows, launchSettingsIntentStatus, renderLaunchSettingsIntentChecklist, isLaunchCommand, renderLaunchCommandHistory, or launchHistoryLine as flat globals.
tests_added: Tightened LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype assertions for namespace-backed Launch settings-intent/history helpers and absence of removed flat assignments.
Updated command-evidence and Launch browser smokes to require Launch history/intent hooks through namespace objects.
manual_validation: npm run webview:contract (OK; regenerated public contract baseline)
npm run webview:prework:check (OK; lint budget 611/630 warnings, generated checks current, script-order smoke passed)
rollback_plan: Restore the six launchView.js flat assignments and the direct flat-global consumer paths in readiness, command-history, launch-history, and smoke tests, then rerun the targeted Local API, command-evidence, Launch browser, inventory, contract, and WebView prework checks.
